links.outcome: Prevalence of hallucination and omission errors in LLM-generated ED discharge summaries
links.effect: GPT-4: 33% error-free; inaccuracies in 10%, hallucinations in 42%, omissions of clinically relevant information in 47%. GPT-3.5-turbo: 10% error-free.
links.quote: Summaries generated by GPT-4 were mostly accurate, with inaccuracies found in only 10% of cases, however, 42% of the summaries exhibited hallucinations and 47% omitted clinically relevant information.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of GPT-4 and GPT-3.5-turbo drafting emergency department discharge summaries, scored by clinicians for inaccuracies, hallucinations, and omissions. It does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
